limitations: The result concerns only the Wang--Yuan--Zhang--Zhu family for one fixed coefficient field k. It does not classify all directed partial orders on C or resolve the Birkhoff--Pierce lattice-order problem. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; the conjugacy proof is a short consequence of the source paper's algebraicity observation and the classical isomorphism-extension theorem for algebraic closures, so unindexed prior or contemporaneous observation remains a material risk. No independent validation is asserted.
provenance: Scientific sources are listed in source_urls; review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
record_title: Conjugacy collapse of explicit directed orders on the complex field
